description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join an early-stage AI startup as its first engineer, partnering closely with the founding team to build a foundational model from the ground up. This hands-on individual contributor role spans novel model architecture, training, and reinforcement learning.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Contribute directly to the development of a foundational model using a novel architecture rather than fine-tuning existing models.

 - Work across the model-building pipeline, including architecture, training, and reinforcement learning.

 - Help establish the engineering foundations for an early-stage AI team.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - A PhD and experience at a frontier AI lab.

 - Hands-on experience contributing as an individual engineer rather than primarily in a management role.

 - Experience spanning foundational model architecture, training, and reinforcement learning.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary up to $400,000, flexible for the right candidate, plus equity. Visa sponsorship details were not provided.


LOCATION

On-site in San Jose, California.
